about: Objects to preview materials on (shader balls), in the samples bucket. Same fields as viewer-samples.json; alt_files are the other files of an asset (format, url, label).

assets.name: shaderball-jesus-sandoval
assets.label: Blender ShaderBall (by Jesus Sandoval)

alt_files.label: Blender 4.0 file (zstd, as Blender saves compressed files)

links.label: CC0, made for the Blender 4.0 release notes and manual (devtalk)

assets.changes: the .blend compressed with zstd (lossless, 41.0 to 27.1 MB; Blender and threepipe read it); the GLB exported from it with threepipe's blend importer, its vertex and index data compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression without quantization (lossless, 6.2 to 3.6 MB). Not in the GLB: the area lights (the importer doesn't read Blender area lights yet) and the colour chart's texture (an external file not packed in the .blend); the camera's lens shift isn't applied by the importer
